d: Job Category Rooms & Guest Services Operations
Location Sheikh Humaid Bin Rashid Al Nuaimi Street, Ajman 8833, United Arab EmiratesVIEW ON MAP

Our jobs aren’t just about giving guests a smooth check-in and check-out. Instead, we want to build and experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Experience Experts take the initiative to deliver a wide range of services that guide guests through their entire stay. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether processing operational needs, addressing guest requests, completing reports, or sharing the highlights of the local area, the Guest Experience Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, protecting company assets, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Experience Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Experience Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
q: Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: No related work experience.

The Luxury Collection Hotels & Resorts, with over 120 properties in more than 35 countries, offers the promise of authentic experiences that evoke lasting, treasured memories. Our more than 100 years of experience, beginning in 1906 under the Italian CIGA brand – a collection of Europe's most celebrated and iconic properties – serves as a solid foundation as we continuously evolve to exceed the desires of the luxury traveler.

From legendary palaces and remote retreats to timeless modern classics, each luxury hotel and resort is a unique and cherished expression of its locale – a portal to the destination’s cultural charms and treasures. If you are someone with an appreciation for evocative storytelling, a keen interest and passion for this destination's heritage, and a desire to deliver genuine, personalized, and anticipatory hospitality, then we invite you on our journey. In joining The Luxury Collection, you join a portfolio of brands with Marriott International. Be where you can do your best work, begin your purpose, belong to an amazing global team, and become the best version of you.

d: The Frontend Developer is responsible for the development, enhancement, and maintenance of user-facing software applications and digital solutions that support the Institute’s clinical, research, and operational activities. The role focuses on delivering responsive, reliable, secure, accessible, and user-friendly interfaces while contributing to DDI’s in-house software development capability.

The role requires close collaboration with backend developers, business users, infrastructure teams, and external technology partners throughout the software lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, integration, testing, deployment, technical handover, and ongoing production support.
q: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related discipline.
Demonstrated hands-on experience in frontend software development, supported by relevant professional experience, internships, academic projects, or a technical portfolio..
Time management and attention to detail.
Strong proficiency in JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
Hands-on experience with React and modern component-based frontend development.
Experience with Bootstrap, responsive design, accessibility, and browser compatibility.
Working knowledge of Node.js and frontend build tooling.
Experience integrating frontend applications with REST APIs.
Experience with PHP and related frameworks is considered an advantage.
Experience with unit testing and automated testing tools such as Jest and Selenium.
Working knowledge of object-oriented programming principles and common application design patterns.
Familiarity with Backbone.js is an advantage for supporting existing applications.
Knowledge of source-code version control, preferably Git, and structured development workflows.
Understanding of secure coding practices, application performance, and maintainability.
Ability to work collaboratively, communicate effectively, and participate in structured technical handovers.
Office-based, may require extended hours during deployments or system rollouts
r: Develop and maintain responsive, accessible, secure, and user-friendly interfaces for DDI software applications and digital solutions.
Translate business and functional requirements into reusable and maintainable frontend components.
Collaborate with backend developers, business users, infrastructure teams, and external technology partners on application changes and integrations.
Contribute to software architecture and frontend design decisions, with attention to usability, performance, security, and maintainability.
Integrate frontend components with REST APIs and other application services.
Write and maintain unit tests and automated user-interface tests, including Jest and Selenium-based tests where applicable.
Execute functional testing and validate new features, fixes, and releases before deployment.
Investigate and resolve frontend issues affecting production systems, integrations, and deployments.
Participate in application releases, upgrades, technical training, handover, and knowledge-transfer activities.
Maintain clear technical documentation for source code, components, configurations, deployment dependencies, and support procedures.
Follow approved development, information security, change-control, and source-code. management practices.
Other relevant duties assigned by the IT Manager.
